title: Fostering is drawn three times: which one is the feature?
detail: (1) farrowing.foster: a Foster piglets page in the farrowing concept (one stepper, send or receive). RULINGS 'After the lock' says fostering is parked and farrowing ships no foster doors, yet the concept still draws it. (2) fostering.* (this feature): Move piglets in the full piglet-processing task (move.html), a drawer with direction, other crate, which piglets, owed doses; RULINGS Round 2 Q13 says Move opens only after farrowing is locked and 'Farrowing's own foster door stays parked'. (3) piglet-processing.move-piglets: the simple prototype's Move, within the batch. The old UI has one fostering flow (Inspection 记录-寄养, 4 screens). Which one is the fostering feature, and does farrowing.foster stay, become an alias, or go?
options: Keep fostering as its own feature on move.html; mark farrowing.foster as parked/earlier
Keep fostering.* as aliases of piglet-processing.move-piglets once the simple prototype is chosen
Keep both: farrowing.foster before the lock, Move after (needs the owner to reopen the farrowing park)
recommendation: Follow the rulings: Move after the lock is the feature. Owner decision 2026-10-10 reopens the park for one case only: when a sow dies, farrowing.foster (the move page, sending out of her litter) is how her piglets go to other sows. Elsewhere it stays parked.
